name: ripple
description: After every code change, tells you what it ripples into: stack and service contracts, security, reliability, efficiency, scalability and cost multipliers. Interactive pane, team awareness ledger.

mode.title: When Ripple reviews
mode.description: smart: after a turn whose changes look risky or sizeable; always: after every turn that changed code; manual: only on /ripple check

sensitivity.title: Smart-mode sensitivity
sensitivity.description: How eagerly smart mode calls the reviewer: relaxed, balanced or eager

reviewer.title: Who reviews
reviewer.description: lean: a separate, cheaper model reads a compact diff plus your last ask (fewest tokens); session: a fork of this whole conversation on your session model (most context, re-reads the transcript from prompt cache)

reviewModel.title: Model for lean reviews and /ripple check
reviewModel.description: Alias or model id: sonnet (balanced) or haiku (cheapest)

ledgerPath.title: Awareness ledger file
ledgerPath.description: Where acknowledged ripples and the scale profile are kept, relative to the project root. Commit it so the team shares awareness. Empty keeps it private to you.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane when new ripples arrive
autoOpen.description: Off: only the band above the prompt and a toast announce them
